title.orig: An Act Declaring August 28 of Every Year a Special Nonworking Public Holiday in the City of Cagayan De Oro to Be Known as "Cagayan De Oro City Day"
title.vi: Ngày Thành phố Cagayan De Oro
title.th: วันเมือง Cagayan De Oro

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2009/ra_9644_2009.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: August 28 of every year is hereby declared a special nonworking public holiday in the City of Cagayan de Oro, Province of Misamis Oriental to celebrate the feast day of St. Augustine, the patron saint of the City, and to be known as "Cagayan de Oro City Day".
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
